The integral splits at \(x=1\):

\[
\int_{1/e}^{e} |\ln x|\,dx
=
\int_{1/e}^{1} -\ln x\,dx
+
\int_{1}^{e} \ln x\,dx
\]

Using \(\int \ln x\,dx = x\ln x - x\):

\[
\int_{1}^{e} \ln x\,dx = 1
\]

\[
\int_{1/e}^{1} -\ln x\,dx = 1 - \frac{2}{e}
\]

So,

\[
\int_{1/e}^{e} |\ln x|\,dx = 1 + 1 - \frac{2}{e} = 2 - \frac{2}{e}
\]

Answer: C
